negative_cases_verified: Leaked official material and self-declared official payloads are refused
Prohibited and unknown licenses are refused; unstated terms are not permission
Sources below the trust floor, oversized payloads and unsupported media types are refused
Archive entries escaping the root, absolute entries, and an absolute entry whose text matches the root are all refused
A prefix-sibling directory is not treated as inside the root
Provenance missing any required field is refused; a non-independent verifier is refused
Skipped lifecycle transitions are refused; activation requires complete provenance
No automatic recovery step destroys learner data, across the whole escalation range
Screening data and secrets are refused in every telemetry mode including opt-in with consent
External scores require provenance, are bounded to 1..99, and are never blended into readiness

hardcoded_fixture_risks: The property suite uses a deterministic PRNG over a fixed hostile alphabet rather than a coverage-guided fuzzer, so its input space is bounded by that alphabet
catch_and_ignore_risks: The fuzz suite originally hung instead of failing, which masked two real performance defects until the harness was made to assert a bound
reason: Five requirements implemented with 106 tests including property/fuzz runs over generated adversarial input and a performance/recovery harness asserting outcomes within a bound. The harness found two genuine production performance defects in the crash-redaction path. 24 of 24 meaningful mutations detected.
real_vulnerabilities_found: verify_no_secrets compiled every redaction regex inline for every field, taking over 40 seconds on a capture with a 50-line log ring; the release gate for crash reports was effectively unusable. Reusing the compiled pattern set made it 0.01s, roughly a 4000x improvement.
scrub_text had the same per-call compilation defect and additionally scanned each field twice. Same fix, single-pass replacement.

The explicit absolute-path guard in archive validation was redundant for the tested cases (containment rejected them anyway) but genuinely needed for an absolute path whose text begins with the extraction root; that case is now tested.
known_limitations: The 484-entry verification registry remains entirely PENDING. Test accounting (V-000..V-021) is EP-010 ship-gate work and cannot be truthfully resolved until the release artifact exists.
Performance bounds are wall-clock assertions on shared hardware in a debug profile and are deliberately generous; they catch order-of-magnitude regressions, not micro-regressions.
Safe mode implements the ladder and durability logic; wiring it to real launch detection in the desktop shell is part of the outstanding Tauri integration.
REQ-050 prompt-injection isolation is enforced on the ingestion side; model-context isolation lives in vector-mcp::capability from EP-004.
